# v1.0.0

Cost-aware GitOps Platform — reference DevOps & FinOps platform release, 2026-11-25.
Repository: https://github.com/workwithcrow12-art/cost-aware-gitops-platform
Python package version: `1.0.0`; release/image tag: `v1.0.0`.

## Highlights

- **Infrastructure as Code & FinOps Governance (`platform-infra/`):**
  - Private AWS EKS environments (`nonprod` with Spot + single NAT; `prod` with On-Demand + configurable `nat_per_az` 3-AZ NAT HA), IMDSv2 enforcement, KMS-encrypted secrets, and S3 remote state locking.
  - Wired `budgets` (optional in `nonprod`, mandatory `nullable = false` in `prod` with `user:env$<env>` cost filters), `cost-reporting` (Athena workgroup, Glue CUR catalog, and `finops-reporter` IRSA), `iam-github-oidc` (supporting shared-account `provider_arn` reuse and wildcard-free subject scoping), and opt-in `karpenter`.
  - Scoped routine operator access (`AmazonEKSViewPolicy` / `AmazonEKSEditPolicy`) separated from optional `break_glass_role_arn` (`AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy`) for initial Argo CD bootstrap and recovery.
  - Mocked `.tftest.hcl` suites across modules and environments, plus credential-free offline Terraform plan generation (`scripts/offline_plan_check.py`) gated by Conftest OPA/Rego cost-tagging policies (`env`, `team`, `project`, `owner`) across `nonprod`, `prod`, `gke`, and `aks` roots.

- **GitOps Delivery & Policy-as-Code (`gitops-config/`):**
  - Cluster-isolated Argo CD bootstraps and `ApplicationSet` environments (`dev`, `staging`, pull-request `preview`, and manual-sync `prod`) with Kustomize overlays pinned to immutable GHCR `@sha256` digests.
  - Automated and manual digest promotion via `.github/workflows/promote-images.yml` (`scanned-images.py --apply-gitops`), opening a reviewed Pull Request across `dev`, `staging`, `prod`, `preview`, and `platform/finops-reporter` after publication.
  - Prometheus-probed Argo Rollouts frontend canaries, weekday off-hours scaling (`GoKubeDownscaler`) in nonprod, Sealed Secrets, default-deny `NetworkPolicy`, and Kyverno `restricted` Pod Security + digest/resource/cost-label policies enforced across both `boutique-*` and `finops` namespaces.

- **Data-Safe FinOps CLI & Cloud Lab Readiness Kit (`finops-toolkit/`, `scripts/`):**
  - Python FinOps CLI (`Decimal` precision) reporting OpenCost Kubernetes allocations separately from AWS CUR/Athena billing (preventing double-counted totals) and rejecting incomplete 14-day UTC comparison windows.
  - Multi-cloud FOCUS 1.0/1.1 CSV spend normalization preserving credits and per-currency totals (`finops cloud-report`), plus read-only Cloud Custodian waste estimation (`finops waste`).
  - Offline-first Cloud Lab Readiness & Evidence Kit (`scripts/cloud_lab_preflight.py`, `scripts/cloud_lab_runner.py`) providing tool/env/private-API preflight checks, itemized regional `Decimal` cost estimates, dry-run execution plans, and secret-redacted live lab evidence capture.

- **CI/CD Supply Chain & Workload Hardening (`.github/workflows/`, `boutique-app/`):**
  - 11 consolidated root GitHub Actions workflows covering continuous validation (`ci.yml`, `finops.yml`, `services.yml`, `terraform.yml`, `gitops.yml`, `images.yml`), generalized `v*` tagged GHCR release & GitOps PR promotion (`release.yml`, `promote-images.yml`), and opt-in OIDC operational workflows (`terraform-apply.yml`, `terraform-drift.yml`, `custodian-weekly.yml`) with zero long-lived cloud secrets.
  - SHA-verified `kubeconform` and `kyverno` CLI gates, Trivy `HIGH`/`CRITICAL` container vulnerability blocking before image push, and hardened multi-language builds across all 11 Online Boutique services plus `finops-toolkit`.

## Publication and promotion workflow

1. Every push to `main` executes `Release validation` (`ci.yml`) across Python, Go (`-race`), Node.js, Java, .NET, Terraform (`fmt`, `validate`, `test`, `tflint`, offline plan Conftest gates), Kustomize/Helm/Kyverno checks, and local container Trivy scans.
2. Pushing tag `v1.0.0` triggers `Publish release` (`release.yml`), which verifies a green `Release validation` run on the exact `main` commit SHA, rebuilds and Trivy-scans all 11 Boutique images and `finops-toolkit:v1.0.0`, pushes verified images to GHCR, publishes this GitHub Release, and invokes `promote-images.yml` to open a reviewed Pull Request pinning the new `@sha256` digests in `gitops-config/`.

## Scope and operational notes

Local unit suites, offline Terraform plans, policy checks, and synthetic FinOps fixtures validate configuration and logic without cloud credentials; live EKS/GKE/AKS provisioning, private-API Argo CD bootstrap, canary rollback timing, and real billing reconciliation require an authenticated cloud lab run documented via `scripts/cloud_lab_runner.py`.
